member.name: T:PhoenixmlDb.Schema.Inference.Conversion.XmlToJson
member.summary:
Converts XML to JSON with optional schema-aware type recovery.
JSON is structurally weaker than XML: no attributes, no required cardinality, no type declarations. This converter "assumes the worst" so the JSON output is unambiguous to consumers: * Elements declared with maxOccurs > 1 in the XSD ALWAYS produce a JSON array, even when only one occurrence is present at runtime. * XML attributes are preserved as JSON object keys prefixed with '@'. * Without an XSD, every leaf is a JSON string. With an XSD, xs:integer, xs:decimal, xs:double, xs:float, and xs:boolean leaves become JSON numbers/booleans; other typed leaves (xs:date, xs:dateTime, xs:anyURI, etc.) remain ISO-encoded strings. * If the runtime value can't be parsed as the declared XSD type, the leaf falls back to a JSON string instead of throwing — the XSD describes the contract, but JSON can't carry it, so failing loud here just punishes the JSON consumer. * Empty leaf elements (no children, no text) become empty JSON strings.
For lossless typed round-trip, prefer XML+XSD over JSON. This converter exists for pipelines that require JSON output, not because JSON is the better representation.
Limitation: only inline complexType definitions are walked. Named complexType references (xs:complexType name="..." outside an element) are not yet resolved; those leaves fall back to string.

member.name: T:PhoenixmlDb.Schema.Inference.Inference.SchemaInferenceEngine
member.summary:
Infers an XSD schema from one or more XML documents.
The generated schema starts loose — all elements optional, types inferred from observed values. As more documents are observed, the schema becomes more accurate: elements seen in every document become required, numeric values produce xs:decimal types, dates produce xs:date, etc.
This is the "schema-on-read with progressive typing" pattern: Day 1: Drop a JSON file → XML + draft schema generated Day 2: Refine schema (make orderId required, total a decimal) Day 7: Add validation step → catches bad data early Day 30: Schema is production-grade, shaped by real traffic
